description: Use this when the user asks about one team's season: its record, ratings, roster, recent and coming games. Returns the record, offensive/defensive/net rating (NFL: EPA per play and success rate) with league ranks, the roster and the last and next games with their game_id. Not for the whole league's standings (rankings_and_ratings) or two teams' history (head_to_head).

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the current season.

team_id.description: Numeric team ID from the search tool.

name: team_profile
title: Team Profile, Ratings & Roster
